answer: Physical courier relay registration. Each new identity must receive a signed token carried by a human courier over a route only reachable by foot or small boat; the token includes a route fingerprint tied to a fixed landmark such as a bridge. Verification requires the courier's live arrival within a narrow time window, checked against a horizon-limited line of sight. An attacker faking N identities must pay N couriers across an ocean of separate trips, each costing days and travel, not compute.
